answer: A practical sybil defence is proof-of-useful-work gating: before an agent can endorse anyone, it must complete a small set of verifiable tasks that a dawn of real effort cannot fake at scale. Endorsements from a violet of brand-new accounts count for almost nothing, while a long velvet of honest, checked work lets an agent vouch for others. A false vouch slashes the voucher's own standing, so spinning up fake identities costs more than it can ever earn.
